item.description:
### Added - Suggest Names… proposes names for a folder's files from a pattern that Treewise recognizes in the names already there, or that you type; you approve each name before anything is renamed. While renaming one file, ⌥Esc offers its proposals. - Patterns with dates in several forms, also with month names in English, Dutch and German, the folder's name, a running number per year, quarter or month, optional parts and choices between parts. A name that nearly fits the pattern is offered written right. Fixed text in an optional part, as `[ correction]`, goes into a proposal only when the file's name already has it. - Saved patterns in Settings > Names, to pick for a folder from the menu beside its pattern. A folder keeps the version it uses, is offered a newer one, and can update the saved pattern. - Add-ons give the values for a pattern, and run in a separate service without internet access. Settings > Add-ons turns them on or off and sets their order. The free add-on reads a file's date and its current name, and recognizes the patterns of a folder's names when most of its files fit one. - Settings > Names can clear what Treewise keeps for each folder you suggest names in. The settings of a folder not seen for 30 days on an attached disk go by themselves. - The address bar starts at your home folder or a cloud folder, shows This Mac as an icon, and puts the parts that do not fit in a menu.
### Changed - Settings has tabs: General, Names and Add-ons. - The home folder shows a blue house in the sidebar and the address bar, so it stands out from the folders around it.
### Fixed - Copying a folder, or moving it to another volume, keeps the folder's Finder tags and other extended attributes. - A file name with a dot but no extension, like `2026.04.28 Permit`, gets `copy` at its end when a name is taken.

### Added - About Treewise links to the website and to the source code, which is now open under the Mozilla Public License 2.0.
### Changed - Downloads and updates now come from the `mag243/treewise` repository.
